messages.body:
Hi Kenzie,

So happy to have you on Barrier Reset. Here's the booking:

- Deliverable: 1 TikTok featuring the Dew Barrier Serum, 900 USD (organic repost on our channels included)
- Draft for approval: by link, by Thursday Oct 1
- Go-live: Tuesday Oct 6
- Code: KENZIE20 (20% off until Oct 11)
- Caption: #ad at the start, plus TikTok's paid-partnership label
- Claims: please stick to the approved claims in the brief - no claims about acne or any other skin condition
- PO number: PO-QM-26-0561 (it goes on your invoice in the Supplier Hub after go-live)

Brief: https://quillmoss.example/briefs/barrier-reset

Speak soon,
Imogen
